annotation.title_clean: The Medicines and Medical Devices Act 2021 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional and Savings Provision) Regulations 2021
annotation.title_en: The Medicines and Medical Devices Act 2021 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional and Savings Provision) Regulations 2021
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department of Health and Social Care (UK Secretary of State); published by King's Printer of Acts of Parliament
annotation.summary_en: UK commencement regulations bringing parts of the Medicines and Medical Devices Act 2021 into force on 26 May 2021, covering enforcement provisions and disclosure of information, with a transitional saving preserving the Consumer Protection Act 1987 offence for medical devices. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Chapter 3 of Part 4 (enforcement), except section 31, commences on 26 May 2021
Sections 39 and 40 and section 41(1)-(8) also commence
Transitional saving keeps Consumer Protection Act 1987 s.12 offence applying to medical devices
Saving ends when section 41(9) and Schedule 3 commence
Extends to England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland
